$comment: The line both SDKs print for a refusal, `Name: meaning (clause)`, per case: read by packages/acp-verify/src/refusal.test.ts and sdk/python/tests/test_refusal_names.py, so the two SDKs are held to the same bytes for the same refusal. `name` null means the site named none. The last three cases are a clause no entry names (a newer engine's), a clause with several names raised without one, and a name that belongs to another clause, which never relabels a refusal. Written from refusals.json once and then kept by hand: a change to a meaning moves a line here in the same commit.

cases.name: ReceiptVersionUnsupported
cases.line: ReceiptVersionUnsupported: what you passed as the receipt is not a version 3 receipt (AB-0)

cases.name: ReceiptTooLarge
cases.line: ReceiptTooLarge: the receipt's signed body is larger than the 4,096 bytes a receipt is signed within (AB-6)

cases.name: SuiteUnknown
cases.line: SuiteUnknown: the receipt names a signature suite this verifier does not know or names none, or the suite floor you configured is not a suite it knows (CR-1)

cases.name: SuiteBelowFloor
cases.line: SuiteBelowFloor: the receipt, or an approval sent with it, is not signed with a suite that contains every algorithm your suite floor requires (CR-4)

cases.name: NotCanonicallyEncodable
cases.line: NotCanonicallyEncodable: the receipt, an approval or the proposal you passed holds a value with no canonical encoding, such as a fractional number, or the proposal bytes are not UTF-8 JSON (AT-8a)

cases.name: SignatureInvalid
cases.line: SignatureInvalid: the receipt's signature does not verify under your trust anchor's keys (9.3-1)

cases.name: DecisionNotAllow
cases.line: DecisionNotAllow: the receipt records a decision other than ALLOW (9.3-2)

cases.name: ReceiptNotBoundToProposal
cases.line: ReceiptNotBoundToProposal: the receipt is not bound to the proposal you passed (9.3-3)

cases.name: ReceiptTimeUnreadable
cases.line: ReceiptTimeUnreadable: the receipt's issue or expiry time is missing or is not an RFC 3339 UTC instant (9.3-5)

cases.name: ReceiptExpired
cases.line: ReceiptExpired: your clock is past the receipt's expiry time (9.3-5)

cases.name: ReceiptIssuedInFuture
cases.line: ReceiptIssuedInFuture: the receipt's issue time is more than 5 seconds ahead of your clock (9.3-5)

cases.name: ValidityWindowTooLong
cases.line: ValidityWindowTooLong: the receipt is valid for longer than the 120 seconds a receipt may be (L-14)

cases.name: NonceMalformed
cases.line: NonceMalformed: a nonce in the receipt, or in an approval sent with it, is not `b64:` followed by padded base64 (WE-4)

cases.name: ReceiptNonceWrongSize
cases.line: ReceiptNonceWrongSize: the receipt's nonce is well formed but is not 128 bits long (L-17)

cases.name: ApprovalsUnverifiable
cases.line: ApprovalsUnverifiable: the approvals sent with the receipt cannot be matched to the list the receipt signed: a list is malformed, an approval is not on it, or the verifier was given no attester registry (AB-1)

cases.name: ApprovalDigestsUnsorted
cases.line: ApprovalDigestsUnsorted: the receipt's list of approval digests is not in sorted order (AB-2)

cases.name: ApprovalDigestsDuplicated
cases.line: ApprovalDigestsDuplicated: the receipt's list of approval digests names one approval more than once (AB-3)

cases.name: ApprovalCountMismatch
cases.line: ApprovalCountMismatch: the number of approvals sent with the receipt is not the number of approvals the receipt signed (AB-4)

cases.name: ApprovalsMissing
cases.line: ApprovalsMissing: the receipt commits to approvals and none were sent with it (INV-1-HIGH)

cases.name: ApprovalObjectMissing
cases.line: ApprovalObjectMissing: an approval sent with the receipt carries no approval object (AT-8)

cases.name: ApprovalObjectMalformed
cases.line: ApprovalObjectMalformed: an approval object lacks a required field, carries a field that is not defined, or holds a field of the wrong type (AT-8b)

cases.name: ApprovalNonceWrongSize
cases.line: ApprovalNonceWrongSize: an approval's nonce is well formed but is not 128 bits long (AT-1)

cases.name: ApprovalSignatureInvalid
cases.line: ApprovalSignatureInvalid: an approval's signature does not verify against the key your attester registry holds for that approver, or your registry does not enrol that approver (9.3-7b-i)

cases.name: ApprovalNotBoundToProposal
cases.line: ApprovalNotBoundToProposal: an approval sent with the receipt is not bound to the proposal you passed (9.3-7b-ii)

cases.name: ApprovalContextMismatch
cases.line: ApprovalContextMismatch: an approval names another policy version than the receipt, expired before the receipt was issued, or has an unreadable policy, expiry or operator field (9.3-7b-iii)

cases.name: ApprovalsDisagreeOnOperator
cases.line: ApprovalsDisagreeOnOperator: the approvals sent with the receipt name different operators (9.3-7b-iii-a)

cases.name: ApprovalQuorumSizeMismatch
cases.line: ApprovalQuorumSizeMismatch: an approver consented to a number of required approvals other than the quorum your attester registry sets (AT-9)

cases.name: ApprovalIdMismatch
cases.line: ApprovalIdMismatch: an approval's transmitted identifier is not the identifier computed from its content (Y1b)

cases.name: ApproverAssuranceTooLow
cases.line: ApproverAssuranceTooLow: an approver is enrolled at an assurance level below your attester registry's floor, or at a level outside AS0 to AS2 (AT-10)

cases.name: QuorumNotMet
cases.line: QuorumNotMet: fewer distinct approvers approved the action than the quorum your attester registry sets (AT-3)

cases.name: OperatorApprovedOwnAction
cases.line: OperatorApprovedOwnAction: the operator who proposed the action is counted among its approvers (AT-2)

cases.name: ApproverKeyTypeMismatch
cases.line: ApproverKeyTypeMismatch: an approval claims a kind of key, a person's passkey or a machine key, that is not the kind your attester registry enrols for that approver (WebauthnAlgMismatch)

cases.name: PasskeyCounterNotAdvanced
cases.line: PasskeyCounterNotAdvanced: a passkey or security key's signature counter did not advance, so the credential was copied or the approval was replayed (WebauthnCounter)

cases.name: ApprovalMalformed
cases.line: ApprovalMalformed: a person's approval, or the key your attester registry holds for them, is not in the shape a passkey approval takes (Malformed)

cases.name: PasskeyAssertionTypeInvalid
cases.line: PasskeyAssertionTypeInvalid: a person's approval is not a passkey sign-in assertion (WebauthnType)

cases.name: PasskeyChallengeMismatch
cases.line: PasskeyChallengeMismatch: a person's approval answers a different request than this approval (WebauthnChallenge)

cases.name: PasskeyOriginMismatch
cases.line: PasskeyOriginMismatch: a person's approval was made on a site other than your approval page (WebauthnOrigin)

cases.name: PasskeyAuthenticatorDataInvalid
cases.line: PasskeyAuthenticatorDataInvalid: a person's approval names another site, or does not show that the person was present and verified (WebauthnAuthenticatorData)

cases.name: PasskeySignatureInvalid
cases.line: PasskeySignatureInvalid: a person's approval signature does not verify against the passkey or security key your attester registry holds for them (WebauthnSignature)
UnnamedRefusal: the receipt was refused under a rule this version of the SDK has no name for (ZZ-99)
ReceiptTimeUnreadable: the receipt's issue or expiry time is missing or is not an RFC 3339 UTC instant (9.3-5)
